notes.title: Raji: An Ancient Epic Enhanced Edition - Now LIVE!
notes.content:
It is with great excitement from our side that we can announce that Raji: An Ancient Epic's ENHANCED EDITION update is here!

What can you find in this update?
[list]
[*] Improved the health gained and lost feedback for Raji and enemies
[*] Improved enemies executions (animations) and health orb spawning
[*] Improved hit impact effects
[*] Improvements to combat VFX
[*] Tightened up many animations for Raji and enemies
[*] Removed dodge animations from heavy attack combos to make them more responsive
[*] Improved combat pacing
[*] Added variations for all enemy types, with fresh new visuals, attacks and abilities
[*] Behavior overhaul and new abilities added for the Chieftain and Mahabalasura bosses
[*] Behavior overhaul and new attacks added for the Mahabalasura boss
[*] Added a camera zoom feature using mouse wheel or Gamepad right analog stick
[*] Added a comprehensive main menu
[*] Added ability to disable tutorials
[*] Added new game modes
[*] Added the option of revisiting locations from previously cleared levels
[*] [strike]Added subtitles for six Indian regional languages[/strike] (coming in a future patch)
[*] Complete SFX overhaul
[*] New background music added to the Fort and Desert level
[*] Hindi voiceovers added
[*] Added Ray-traced Shadows, Ambient Occlusion, Reflections and Global Illumination
[*] Added Nvidia DLSS and AMD FSR (1.0) upscaling options
[*] Many bugs fixed
[/list]
[h3]Important[/h3]
As we mentioned [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/730390/view/3192501289521195923]here[/url], we encountered some issues with the subtitles for the various Indian regional languages. As such, the subtitles had to be removed for the launch day. However, we are working to fix the problems and will add them to the game in a (near) future patch.

notes.title: Raji: An Ancient Epic Update “Developers vs Code Demons!”
notes.content:
[h3]Good news everyone,[/h3]

Since the launch of the game, we’ve been closely monitoring the various issues that you in our community have been reporting to us. Needless to say, all of the bugs that have been reported to us have been noted and passed to our developers to fix up, and now, we’re ready to announce the first update to Raji: An Ancient Epic!
[h3]
Developers vs Code Demons - The Patchnotes![/h3]
Before we begin, we just want to make clear that this update focuses entirely on bugfixes and so is designed to improve the general quality of life for all of our players.

[b]So, what have we fixed?[/b]

[h3]Frame-rate/FPS Related Issues[/h3]
There were two major locations in the game where the game was almost unplayable if the player was on a high-end system (and so had high frames per second), these were:
[list]
[*] 
[*] When Raji had to pull the rope down from the giant bow
[*] When Raji encountered the Naga and needed to use stealth to avoid it.
[/list]
This bug has now been fixed, so if you have manually put in a frame rate cap via the GameUserSettings.ini file, or via any third-party software, you may now remove it and play the game with the maximum performance that your hardware allows.

[h3]Raji Gets Stuck[/h3]
One of the main pain-points that our community highlighted was that there are several locations where, if Raji tried to move on/around, would result in the character getting stuck, requiring a restart from your last save point. The stuck locations that we have fixed are:

During the sequence where Raji sees the giant bow and has to run a gauntlet while the terrain crumbled, it was possible for Raji to get stuck on the cliffs, with no option other than to fall.
A general issue (across all levels) caused Raji to sometimes get stuck in the floor, most commonly encountered after crossing the first bridge in the first level.

We do hope that the fixes for these issues will mean that Raji will no longer get stuck in all locations as you play the game.

[h3]Tutorial Mission for the Bow[/h3]
Soon after unlocking the bow, a tutorial mission is triggered and the player needs to complete a set of combos. However, many players would swap to the Trishul and attempt to complete the tutorial with the Trishul, not knowing that the Bow is required. To fix this, when the tutorial starts, Raji will automatically swap weapons to the Bow.

[h3]Quality of Life/Game Experience Fixes and Changes[/h3]
All of these points are important, however, do not follow a specific theme, so they’re listed here.
[list]
[*] Sometimes Raji would not jump far enough to reach a wall run section,
[*] In rare instances, jumping on a Lotus would cause Raji to die,
[*] Steam Achievements would either take far too long to update or in rare cases, not update at all.
[*] When loading the game (or reviving) from specific checkpoints, the start position was in an awkward place preventing Raji from being able to move.
[*] The colour scheme of the red wall in the temple has been slightly altered, making it easier for the player to know where to go.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/fc11269959d5bc9e2150e6b8c22347be157bf4ad.png[/img]

We’d like to thank everyone in our community for reporting the bugs to us, it really is with your help that we were able to identify and fix these issues. As always, after updating the game, please continue to report any new and/or old bugs to us as we are constantly working on improving the game.

Thank you very much,
Your Raji Team!

notes.title: Important Update to Raji: An Ancient Epic
notes.content:
[h3]Good afternoon everyone,[/h3]

Launch week has flown by us and it’s been a really amazing experience to watch people from all over the world come together and enjoy Raji: An Ancient Epic!

We also noticed something really special from this community that we want to highlight. Simply put, the level of support that you have shown us-and-each other, and the way that you all have banded together to help bring awareness of the game to all corners of the internet has been frankly amazing. So, a huge thank you to everyone!

[h3]Post Launch Issues and Fixes[/h3]
One thing that every game ever launched will have are a few nagging issues that are only picked up on after the game’s launch. 

Why’s that you may ask? Surely we tested everything, so how did this happen?

The reason for this is down to the huge variance that exists from each PC set up. Take our studio for example, even between us where we use similar systems, what our Game Designer, Avichal Singh uses is different from what our Game Artists Ian Maude and Shruti Ghosh use, and it’s not just the hardware, it’s the software configuration. Now think about the countless number of people playing Raji and the hardware and software combinations will explode. From our side, we tested the game with over 40 different hardware and software configurations that covered the most popular specifications to ensure that everything was working well. With that said, we were always on standby in case unforeseen issues came up - and so we were ready to act when we began receiving reports from our community. 

A huge thanks to our Game Programmers who have been hyper-focused on an update to Raji - one that we just pushed live now!

[h3]The Update - Listening to the Community[/h3]
Our update covers two main points. The first is straight forward, we realized that there was an interesting exploit that allowed players to defeat the Chieftain very easily, the frustrating thing about this was that players could accidentally come across it and so would have their gaming experience somewhat damaged as the fight would become very anticlimactic, so we’re happy to have this bug fixed and we hope that you will be as well.

The second point is perhaps more important to a rather large group in our community, and that is the DRM. To give it to you short, this update has removed the DRM from our game, and so any bugs that are related to the DRM will vanish.

The point of DRM is always a very sensitive topic for gamers. On one hand, DRM can be vital to developers as it slows down (never stops) the more unscrupulous types from pirating the game. However, even the best of DRM will have its issues, sometimes it can block honest players who have done nothing wrong, or sometimes it can harm the game’s performance. That said, we want to be clear that our DRM did not impact performance, something we are very proud of.

With that said, looking at the feedback of our community, we saw that there were too many players that had purchased the game and were unable to play it - an unacceptable situation to everyone who works on the game. Then, we also had the players that for personal reasons extremely dislike DRM due to the reputation and nature of it, something that we have nothing against at all, after all, we are gamers at heart as well and can understand some of the sentiments behind it.

So, after listening to what our community has had to say, and after doing our best to try to help the innocent - but affected players - we made the decision (today) to remove the DRM from our game with this update. All you need to do is update the game and it will be gone.

Anyone that has had a problem with ‘[Cord] Game load failed’ should now be able to play.

[h3]Looking to the Future[/h3]
We know that this update is a rather small one, however especially with the DRM issue, we are sure that you will all agree that this was a vital update. There are more things that need working and there are some other bugs that need squashing, so rest assured that we are now preparing work on a much larger update - but one that will take a bit longer to put together.

notes.title: Now Supporting Hindi and Turkish Subtitles!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone![/h3]

Launch week is finally here, just 3 more days until our game goes live, so we hope that you are all just as excited as we are!

Of course, just because it is launch week, it doesn't mean that the work stops. For the most part, we've been mainly focusing on fixing the lingering bugs, however, we were able to find the time to do something special for the game, thanks to a huge show of support from our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/b03e243edb74859a775e956277434f5b11d221b9.jpg[/img]

So, we are pleased to announce that Raji: An Ancient Epic now has Hindi and Turkish subtitles! We pushed out the update to the Steam Game Festival demo and our prologue versions early on Saturday so you can activate the new subtitles right away!

We are especially happy to be able to launch the subtitles now as we have been working with the tightest timetables possible, so it was a fun-but-tough challenge for us to have it ready for the game's launch!

We would like to thank everyone who contacted us requesting these languages, we always feel incredibly blessed to see that our community cares about the game this much.


[h3]Further News From Raji[/h3]
For people that are playing the Raji demo via the Steam Game Festival, we realized that the version was slightly outdated (behind the Prologue version) so we have updated it to bring the demo to version parity. This update brought in a few much-needed bugfixes and small balancing changes.

Finally, we'd like to remind you that we are running a special [url=https://gleam.io/PJdt5/raji-an-ancient-epic-giveaway]Raji giveaway contest[/url]. Enter today to have a chance to win a copy of the PC (Steam) version of Raji: An Ancient Epic! 

The event will run until 23:59 CEST on the 14th of October.
[list]
[*] Winners will be contacted during the morning (CEST) on the 15th of October so that they know that they have won before the game's launch.
[*] Prizes will be distributed in the form of Steam keys as soon as (humanly) possible after the game goes live!
[/list]

Thank you very much and we hope that you're enjoying our prologue while you wait for the game's launch!

notes.title: Information on the Raji: An Ancient Epic DEMO
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone[/h3]

We have some special news for you regarding our current demo and how long it is going to be available to you.

[h3]Updating the Demo[/h3]
We want to start by thanking you all for the overwhelming support that you have shown us since the launch of our recent demo. It is great to see so many of you playing the game and posting about it on social media, not only does this help gets eyes on us, but it also speaks out for the Indian game dev community.

We also thank everyone who has reported bugs and issues on the demo, some of these have been addressed and we will be releasing an update very shortly to fix these.

With that said, we wanted to inform you (and be transparent with you) that the current demo build is from June 2020, the last Steam Game Festival.

Since then we have been occupied with the Switch launch, and now XBOX, PS4, and PC development. Due to the tight schedule, we couldn't make a new demo build in time for the event's start.

However, the good news is that we now have some time and the next demo version should address issues such as the tutorial being too tough, Raji flying around the level, resolution problems, and many more such issues and bugs, which were fixed since the last Steam Game Festival.

We're hoping to update the demo by the end of today!

[h3]Extending the Demo period[/h3]
Originally we had announced that our demo was only going to be available over the weekend. However, this has now changed and the availability has been extended to the 20th of September as we are taking part in PAX Online 2020.

So this means that you have more time to enjoy our upcoming updated demo!

Greetings everyone,

The Guerrilla Collective festival has started and Raji: An Ancient Epic is taking part!

For this event AND the upcoming Steam Game Festival, we have once again made our demo playable.

We hope that you'll enjoy test-playing Raji: An Ancient Epic!

notes.title: Raji News Blast - Get to know what we have been working on!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

For this week's news blast, we're going to be doing something a little different and sharing a bit of what we have been working on.

As you know, we recently had a pretty successful demo that was playable during the Steam Game Festival, and from that, we received a lot of feedback. Since the event ended, we have been hard at work gradually going through what you told us and working on improving our game.

So, how does this relate to this week's article? Well, we are going to give you a sneak peek into the work that we have been doing.

[h1]Updating Icons[/h1]
Starting with something light-hearted - the icons in our game are getting a big overhaul. Why is that you ask? Well, we received some very interesting feedback that led to a 'once seen, it can't be unseen' moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/f26e82c04ae19330955776e37133154db5bc720a.png[/img]

It was pointed out to us that the original icon (see on the bottom) resembled a pair of pants. 

Of the 9 new options, which do you like the most?

[h1]Improving the Visual Effects[/h1]
Pretty much all of the Visual Effects (VFX) are getting a touch-up. That said, thanks to the feedback we received, we have a clear starting point - the special attacks.

Here you can see a small sample of what we have been working on.

[previewyoutube=NPu01NbRy3k;full][/previewyoutube]

What's more, as well as upgrading the effects for the Trishul, we also went straight to work improving the other weapons in the game. (The bow and an as-of-yet unrevealed weapon!)

[h1]AI Improvements[/h1]
Moving to something that affects the actual gameplay directly. This is something that has been on our to-do list for quite a while, the AI that controls the demons are getting an update. So watch out, Raji is going get a bit more challenging!

Though we don't have a way to show you what this looks like just yet, we thought that it would be an interesting point for you to know nonetheless!
[i]That said, we are looking for fun ways to show and explain the changes that we're making to the AI, it will just need a bit more organizing from our side.[/i]

So that's it for this week's update, we hope that you've enjoyed getting to know a bit more of what we have been working on.

And remember everyone, take care, stay safe, and wash your hands!

notes.title: Raji News Blast - Our 3rd Anniversary!
notes.content:
Today Nodding Heads Games are celebrating our third anniversary! It’s been an amazing journey so far and we cannot wait to finally release Raji: An Ancient Epic to the public! 

Just a few more months to go and our dream will come true!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/957d98201050baaff6416dc35717510372e1c10d.jpg[/img]

Thank you to everyone for your amazing support, we would not have made it this far without you!

[h1]Work In Progress - The Jalsure[/h1]
We're playing around with a secondary ability for the Jalsura. Not only would it have its offensive ability (the concentrated light beam), but we're trying out a defensive ability - creating a protective shield around another demon.

[previewyoutube=vkGXMIJApMo;full][/previewyoutube]

What is your take on this ability, do you think that it would improve the combat experience and variety?

notes.title: Raji News Blast - Recognition around the World!
notes.content:
[h1][b]2019 Indie DB Players Choice [/b][/h1]
The 2019 IndieDB player's choice best upcoming indie game results are in and thanks to your help, from 100 awesome games, Raji came in third!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/8603115c315dff4d5d6823ef533b73e909cd93e4.png[/img]

That is a fantastic result and we are extremely grateful to everyone who voted for us!


[h1][b]Raji in the Newspaper[/b][/h1]
The Times of India, one of the biggest newspapers in India, recently wrote an article about Indian game developers and how they have begun to grab the attention of people from around the world. 
Whatsmore, in the article, we were honored to be recognized as being instrumental in helping the Indian Gaming industry receive global attention!
Check out what they had to say about us and the ever-growing Indian game developer scene!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/34c7302ae84aaebefdd4c5455bb1d775f641e4dd.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Steam Demo[/b][/h1]
As you may know, for a while we have had a playable demo of our game on Steam. 
 
However, this demo was created for our Kickstarter campaign making it over two years old and in that time we have pretty much re-worked the entire game making the demo extremely outdated. 
Whatsmore, we have noticed that this has caused some confusion in our community as players have been judging the game based on this outdated demo - something that we really do not want to happen.
So to prevent our new community members from getting confused, we have decided to remove our steam demo. If you already have the demo, nothing will happen (you can manually delete it if you want), however, new members of the community will not be able to download the old demo.
If you are interested in seeing just how different the game is, check out this video that compares the scene where Raji receives her first weapon, the Trishul.
https://youtu.be/BtwgEmIF_7s 

[h1][b]Game Development - Movement Leads to Combat[/b][/h1]
Shortly after releasing our Kickstarter demo (two years ago) we received a lot of feedback from players who commented that Raji’s movement felt clunky and repetitive.
After studying what the players wrote, we agreed with the conclusion and set to work on improving this. We did this by taking up a new mindset that we called ‘Movement leads to combat’.
One of the first things that we implemented after adopting this mindset was the triple dodge mechanic that you can see in this video.
Notice how Raji has three different moves and each one flows seamlessly from one to the next.

https://youtu.be/N2frXdB6SQU 



That’s it for this news blast, we hope that you’re just as excited for the game as we are!

notes.title: Raji News Blast - Return of the Dev Blog!
notes.content:
[h1]The Raji Dev Blog[/h1]
After a two year break, we finally restarted the Raji dev blog over on IndieDB. The latest edition was our fourth article in the series and focused on the feedback (mainly combat-related) that we received and how we used it to improve the game. 

Before you read the article, check out this quick before and after video to see if you can identify the main ways that we improved combat in our game.

[previewyoutube=0sf-nH2cdpQ;full][/previewyoutube]

After that, be sure to read the full dev blog [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/raji-an-ancient-epic/news/devblog4-reacting-to-feedback-and-improving-combat]here[/url]

Lately, we’ve been doing something a little different on our Social Media channels. 

We’ve been sharing snapshots from our development build (taken from when we were block-testing the game) and then asked our community members to let us know what they thought about the new features that we put on display.

This week we shared a new mechanic - a way for Raji to travel over larger expanses of water. When Raji has to cross water, she can pick up items that generate a temporary platform.

[previewyoutube=xnW2Pj7-dxo;full][/previewyoutube]

Do you like this way of crossing water, or would you like to see us handle water crossing in a different way? Keep in mind that Raji's major weakness is water - so she cannot swim!

notes.title: Raji News Blast - IndieDB Top 100
notes.content:
Fantastic news coming from Indie DB. In the first round of voting, Raji: An Ancient Epic was popular enough to make it to the top 100 best upcoming indie games for 2019, and by doing so, we have moved to the next round.

For this final round, we have been placed in the best upcoming adventure game category, and we are up against some very good looking, and well-designed games. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/a1ec7b70a5bd6a59a7ec8ec14ac8babbd4711894.jpg[/img]

So, we need you - our awesome community - to let your voices be heard! If you feel that Raji: An Ancient Epic is the best upcoming adventure Indie game, please head over to our [url=https://www.indiedb.com/games/raji-an-ancient-epic]Indie DB[/url] page and give us your vote. 

While you are there, be sure to check out the other categories in the competition, you may find a gem of a game!

[h1]Introducing the Jalsura[/h1]
If you have been with us since our Kickstarter days, you may have heard of a demon that we created for the game called the Jalsura - this was because we shared the concept art for this unique demon, and it proved to be very popular. 

Here is a quick reminder for those of you that do not remember:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/b4d4b0324d46451b12ed44a1769efb2eaae73d60.jpg[/img]

Though this demon did not make it into the demo, that was simply because we wanted to introduce it in a future level - a level that we have recently been working on.

Can you guess where we’re going with this? If you guessed that we now have some footage of this demon to share, then you guessed correctly! 

[previewyoutube=tpxia2cCZ58;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s more, we have some early work-in-progress footage of the Jalsura in combat. Do keep in mind that we recorded this during our blocking test phase, so there will be heavy improvements to the entire experience before the game is released.

[previewyoutube=_z9s38qUHp8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Melee - The New Gaming Social Media platform by Imgur![/h1]
Did you know that Imgur has released a new gaming-focused community platform for iOS called Melee?

Though it is new, we are bringing Raji: An Ancient Epic to this platform to see what it is like and how it works, after all, it is exciting to be an early adopter.

For now, this platform can only be accessed via an app that is only available for iOS, so if you have an Apple device, why not go check it out and if you like it, be sure to follow Raji there as well!

If you want more information about this new platform, check out what Imgur have to say about it [url=https://blog.imgur.com/2019/12/05/we-made-a-new-thing-meet-melee-an-app-for-gamers/]here[/url].

notes.title: Raji News Blast - Blocktober comes to an end
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to this week’s news blast!

This week we’re focusing on new content, from new demons to a first look at an all-new level, all while saying a fond farewell to Blocktober.

[h1]New Level and the end of Blocktober[/h1]

October has come to an end, bringing our fun Blocktober coverage to an end with it, but we’re ending things with a bang as this is a great opportunity to tease an upcoming level that we recently tested in the block phase. 

[previewyoutube=54XGOKCTtU0;full][/previewyoutube]

This new level is set in the capital city, and our heroine Raji has to fight her way through new types of demons to get to her goal.

Speaking about new demons, let us properly introduce...

[h1]The Jalsura[/h1]
In our teaser video, you may have noticed some new enemies that fight in very different ways, a giant eyeball, and a flying demon. The giant eyeball is called the Jalsura and you can see it in action here.

[previewyoutube=0hG_9YI1XMQ;full][/previewyoutube]

That’s it for this update, though it is short, we hope that you can agree that it is packed with a lot of new things. 

We’re aiming to release the game sometime in Q1 of 2020 and until then we will be hard at work developing our game. 

In the meantime, you can get a feeling for our game by trying our demo, available here on steam. What’s more, we will update the demo before the full game’s release as we’ve made a lot of changes to the game since the demo was first created.

Be sure to follow us on our main social media channels for all the latest Raji news.

notes.title: Raji Weekly News Blast - Introducing the team dogs!
notes.content:
Hello and welcome everyone!

The weekly Raji news blast is back, and this week we are continuing with our theme of Blocktober, and (maybe more exciting for our community) we are also introducing the Raji team dogs!

[h1]Blocktober Continues[/h1]
In our last news blast, we introduced Blocktober to you, telling you what it was, and why we're taking part as well. If you haven't read the post yet, we do recommend that you check it out [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/730390/announcements/detail/1586880891240019487]first[/url].

So for this news blast, we have two Blocktober videos to share with you.

[h1]Bloctober - Wall Run[/h1]
The first looks at the before and after of the first Wall Run that Raji is forced to perform.

[previewyoutube=hIywsQRLQtU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Blocktober - Combat[/h1]
The second video looks at combat. Notice how in the blocking phase, we had already planned for the tutorial by making notes on the ground itself.
Also, some of the block encounters were found to be a bit too hard (like fighting three Gadasura demons) so we toned it down a little bit to two.

[previewyoutube=KhXW98bCxf8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Raji Team Dogs[/h1]
Meet the Raji team dogs! These dogs are one of the main reasons why we've managed to maintain our sanity while developing Raji: An Ancient Epic!

All of them were taken in from the streets and are now vital members of the team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30912759/58331d70cb118c9cf929b1b57c64831c0654ea71.png[/img]

From the mouth of the Raji team, the dogs in the photo are:
[i]Killer is in the mix three times... cheeky chappy. 
From top left, we have Benji, little Patch, Killer, 
Left middle row, Hailey [the Alpha], Zia [Killers sister] and Peter, 
Bottom left, Killer, Killer again and then we finish with Nimi. 

We're missing Mr G. Goldie. Each one has their own story, Nimi was only meant to stay with us until her leg healed - she was hit by a car, we'll spare you the details. Once she was fit and well, it was I who said, I can't let her go, Normally it's Shru.

Shru organized a Rabies vaccination drive a while ago in the local area with a couple of dog groups where they would go out and vaccinate as many of the dogs over a weekend. Before releasing they'll be rewarded with nice reflective collars and a few treats.[/i]

[h1]Work In Progress[/h1]
We're ending this week's post by taking a look at a WIP video, taken from an upcoming level that we are working on for the game.

[previewyoutube=zMPLjuGGeuA;full][/previewyoutube]

The peaceful scene is quite different from the regular war-torn scenery that we've shared from Raj: An Ancient Epic so far.

We hope that you've enjoyed this news blast and we'll be back next week with more awesome videos and photos from the world of the Raji developers!

notes.title: Raji: An Ancient Epic - Summer News Blast Volume 2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30912759/97a8e6e3ba0ac3477677e703cbac0a307b86d147.png[/img]

We’re back with another news blast from the world of Raji development. In our last small update, we had some excellent feedback from the Steam community that had not seen the in-development videos yet, so this article will focus on sharing some more of our recent videos. As always, if you really like them, we highly recommend that you follow us on Facebook as we upload new content there on a regular basis.

[b]Our full social media list is:[/b]
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rajithegame
Twitter: https://twitter.com/rajithegame
Instagram: https://instagram.com/rajithegame/
VK (Russian only): https://vk.com/rajithegame

[h1]Creating the Bow[/h1]
The focus of this post is on how we’ve added the Bow mechanic to the game, so we will be showcasing single attacks, special attacks, poking (shoot and dodge) and a special ‘bug-that-could-become-a-feature’ video that ended up being very popular!

Before we get into the videos showing you the Bow in action, check out this quick concept-to-creation slideshow, showing you the various stages of the Bow’s development.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OAJls7MZBXg 

Starting with the bow’s basic attack, Raji simple draws an arrow and releases it at the unsuspecting Gadasura!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rgIgn-Vs0U4 

The Bow also has a special attack, Raji is able to channel her power into firing multiple arrows high into the air until they rain down on her target.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TkeV58USLgc 

If you are an agile player, you can ‘poke’ your opponents with the Bow. Poking is a common tactic in games where you constantly run in and out of range when fighting an opponent. Though it requires skill to do, if you master it, your opponent cannot land any hits against you!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oA_E8UGf0_I 

Finally, as we were testing the bow’s attacks, we came across a bug that looked so good it could have been a feature:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cfhhC9vtu7I 

To wrap things up, we’ve got another new demon (not in the game yet) to share with you. This one is called the Jalsura.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30912759/b4d4b0324d46451b12ed44a1769efb2eaae73d60.jpg[/img]

Can you guess how this demon will behave and attack?

notes.title: Raji: An Ancient Epic Summer News Blast!
notes.content:
It’s been a while since we’ve posted an update for our loyal Steam followers, so what better time than now to give you run down at what has been going on with Raji: An Ancient Epic!

[h1]New Demo[/h1]
As you know, we are currently hard at work developing the game and we are currently working to complete a new demo for you to play!

What will be new in this demo?

[list]
[*] Gameplay has new features and also been heavily improved
[*] We’ve added new types of attacks and combos
[*] The quality of the environment has been improved
[*] Cinematics and narration has been added to the game
[*] We’ve added Parkour to the game
[/list]

All of these improvements and additions will mean that the new demo will be a significant upgrade on our existing one, so we’re looking forward to seeing your reaction to the game.

[h1]Raji In Development[/h1]
If you follow us on Social Media, you’ll have seen us post a few videos showing some development videos of the game!

Here are a few samples that we’ve shared in the last few weeks!

The developers decided to have some fun while testing the facial expressions of the Gadasura!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lbYvwEWN0BA
Very early on in the Tezabsura's development cycle, we had to get the jump mechanics to work properly. This particular version didn't work properly, but the resulting jump-party made for an interesting video!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DGTT12dAQZY 
Finally, we have an all new-new demon that we are working on for the game. Though we’ve (intentionally) not given much information about it just yet, we’re very happy to share its concept art with you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30912759/b87e20f9e58577556a28e7002142057d28ae18b4.jpg[/img]

That’s it for now, if you are interested in seeing more development snapshots, we recommend that you follow us on Facebook, and we’ll see you again soon!
